name: Sethir's Journal
summary: On Teldrassil, Sethir's Journal was recovered through stealth. Its pages show that corruption from mainland Kalimdor has reached the World Tree.

sections.title: A Clue to the Taint
sections.body:
Sethir's Journal was taken by stealth from Sethir the Ancient, a solitary satyr near the Oracle Glade. Teldrassil was raised in hope of restoring elven immortality, yet sickness has taken root among its boughs.

In Darnassus, Syurna suspected Sethir held answers. Scouts who tried to bargain or attack him met death, so the journal was lifted from his packs. Its writings show that the blight poisoning the woods and waters across the sea in Darkshore has reached Teldrassil.

faq.answer: Sethir's Journal is carried by Sethir the Ancient, a hostile satyr on the outer branches near the Oracle Glade. Its notes describe corruption spreading through the region.

aliases: how do i get sethirs journal
faq.answer: Scouts who tried to bargain with or fight Sethir met failure and death. The journal must be lifted from his packs through stealth.
Rogue trainer Syurna says the journal proves the strange sickness blighting Darkshore's forests and waters has reached Teldrassil.

Sethir the Ancient is a solitary satyr on a secluded branch near the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. He deals violently with interlopers and holds information about corruption spreading across the World Tree.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can use stealth and pickpocketing to find vital intelligence where warriors and diplomats failed.
As a Night Elf, you face evidence that Teldrassil is not immune to the ancient demonic taint spreading across mainland Kalimdor.
